summary: Klamath County, OR: a 1938 cab on Deschutes National Forest land, removed or destroyed in 1954. A 1958 USGS description mentions a microwave mast and no lookout.

facts.status_note: Cab removed or destroyed in 1954; the 1958 USGS description, as summarized online, mentions a microwave mast at the summit and no lookout

events.note: The register, firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb all date the cab to 1938
The register says removed; firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed
USGS description of a microwave mast at the summit, with no lookout mentioned (as summarized on WillhiteWeb.com)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cab was removed in 1954; firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say it was destroyed that year. All three place the end of the cab in 1954, and the sources do not say how it left the summit.

notes_for_editor: Brief record agrees with the register on coordinates, and with the register and firelookout.com on name, Klamath County and 5,209 ft (firelookout.com shows no coordinates). Record agency 'U.S.Forest Service' is consistent; facts.agency narrows it to Deschutes National Forest per the register and firelookout.com. The 1958 microwave-mast item comes from WillhiteWeb's summary of a USGS description and was not checked against the USGS record. WillhiteWeb's photos were not used because their licence is unknown. The Forest Service Crescent-area page was read and does not mention the lookout. No source describes the summit today or its access rules.
